text:
toni_support: FYI customer reported a surge of 504s and timeouts hitting hosted inference around 09:32 UTC. They see long tail latency (p95+6000ms) and a bunch of gateway 5xx errors. sample request ids: rq_0a4f1, rq_0a4f2, rq_0a4f7

dan_sre: Thanks — any repro or pattern? per-tenant or global?

toni_support: Appears tenant-scoped (acme-corp). Error logs attached from our gateway: 
```
ERROR gateway: request_queue: full -> reject 504 tenant=acme-corp req_id=rq_0a4f1 queue_depth=512 max_depth=512
WARN continuous_batcher: enqueue_latency=120ms backlog=2400 active_batches=48
ERROR runtime: request_timeout tenant=acme-corp p95=6100 p99=12300
```

ashley_sales: Customer says this started after they ran a burst of long-sequence jobs (avg seq_len ~ 6k tokens).

maria_platform: I noticed a deploy around 09:20 from deploy-bot that changed continuous-batcher config for thinpool sizes. deploy-bot posted: 
```
deploy-bot: svc/continuous-batcher rolled to v2.14 — default batch_timeout reduced from 60ms -> 30ms; kvcache_prefetch enabled
```

dan_sre: Hmm reduced batch_timeout could increase number of small batches and pressure queue depth for long seqs. Also kvcache_prefetch might trigger more KV churn for tenants with many open contexts.

tonI_support: Reproduction steps from customer: send ~200 parallel requests with 4–6s generator time each (long seq). They provided curl sample: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"open-llama-70b","input":"<long prompt>","max_tokens":6000}' &
```
We can repro locally if we run ~150 concurrent with long max_tokens.

dan_sre: Can you paste the gateway trace for one of the failed request ids?

toni_support: Trace for rq_0a4f1: 
```
gateway -> router: enqueued (queue_depth=512)
router -> batcher: attempted assign (no slot)
batcher -> router: backlog=2400, active_batches=48, kv_misses rising
router -> gateway: reject 504 (deadline exceeded)
```

maria_platform: Short-term mitigation options: 1) bump tenant queue_limit for acme-corp, 2) temporarily disable continuous-batcher for that tenant (fall back to direct runtime allocation), 3) route long-seq requests to dedicated capacity if available.

dan_sre: Agreed. Also we should roll back the recent batch_timeout change for thinpools or set an override for long-seq tenants. I'll try #2 first (disable CB for tenant) and increase queue depth to 1024.

maria_platform: I'll open a rollout: override continuous-batcher.enabled=false for tenant=acme-corp now. Also increasing queue_limit -> 1024 for that tenant.

tonI_support: Customer on the line — I'll notify them now that we're applying mitigations. :phone:  

ingress-bot: action: update-tenant-config tenant=acme-corp {"continuous_batcher.enabled": false, "ingress.queue_limit": 1024} by maria_platform at 09:45 UTC

dan_sre: After the change I'm seeing queue_depth drop and p95 tail come down to ~350ms for a short test load. Still watching for p99.

tonI_support: Customer confirms errors reduced, but they want a postmortem and a permanent fix.

maria_platform: Follow-ups: revert thinpool batch_timeout change in next deploy or add an automatic tenant-driven batch policy (larger batch_timeout for long-seq tenants). I'll ticket for rollout revert and a policy PR.

dan_sre: Action items: (1) run a controlled repro with 200 long-seq concurrent jobs and validate CB off vs on (assign to me), (2) add tenant-specific batching overrides (maria), (3) prepare communication for customer and support (toni + ashley_sales).

ashley_sales: I'll coordinate customer comms and request their preferred SLA remediation.

tonI_support: Marking incident closed for now — mitigation applied and customer happy. Will follow up with postmortem when PRs are scheduled. :white_check_mark:
